prediction_question: For a CPCB continuous ambient air-quality monitoring station in India, will the station's next-day (D+1) 24-hour mean PM2.5 concentration exceed 90 micrograms/m3 - the lower breakpoint of the CPCB National AQI 'Poor' band for 24-hour PM2.5 - given only that station's own hourly PM2.5 history through the end of day D?
prediction_time: 23:59 IST on day D: every hourly reading through day D is knowable at that instant and no D+1 reading exists yet. Features are the station's own trailing hourly/daily PM2.5 statistics and calendar terms only; every D+1 measurement is label source and never ships as a feature.
target_definition: Binary and mechanical from the source series: mean of the station's hourly PM2.5 values on D+1 > 90 micrograms/m3. The label source is the D+1 PM2.5 series itself, excluded from all shipped columns; the runner ships only the binary label. The threshold is a published, documented band edge (CPCB National AQI breakpoints), not a human judgement.

split_strategy: Temporal by day, computed at construction on the cpcb_caaqm stream only (5 us_embassy DS* stations excluded so the population is one instrumentation stream). Archive re-measured 2026-11-04 (XKDR export 2026-09-30): PM2.5 effectively ends 2025-12 - ZERO of 549 CPCB PM2.5 stations have last_seen in 2026 - so candidate windows are train 2019-2023 / eval 2024 / holdout 2025 (330 stations live into 2025; 135 stations started <= 2019-01 giving train-era depth; 87 more started 2009-2017). Eval-window coverage measured 2026-11-04: 534 stations with 2024 PM2.5 (466 with all 12 months; 495-524 station-months each month). Both classes plausible per window (monthly-mean >90 share 2024: Jan 0.317, Nov 0.308, Dec 0.203 vs Jul-Sep 0.004; annual 0.1027) but the DAILY label's exact per-window class counts are the first construction measurement (demo tier reads 2024 files only; 2019-2023 and 2025 daily passes need a full free signup key or the OpenAQ archive).

novelty_check.theirs: Papers with private splits on their own pulls of CPCB data; open data mirrors of the raw readings; no published train/eval/holdout prediction task with a scored contract on this source was found
novelty_check.ours: A packaged station-level next-day 'Poor-or-worse' PM2.5 exceedance task on the CPCB CAAQMS network: mechanical band-edge label, temporal splits, monthly-refreshable windows from an anonymous documented archive (OpenAQ), and the runner contract. The task does not exist in ML-ready form anywhere found; the heavy literature is what makes a measured benchmark of it valuable rather than redundant.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
